definition: A person who works the land or who keeps livestock, especially on a farm.

definition: A solitary, mainly nocturnal bird of prey, belonging to the order Strigiformes; it has large forward-facing eyes and ears and a hawk-like beak, and it can turn its head 180 degrees around.

label: ox
definition: A castrated bull.

label: oysters
definition: Name for different families of inhabitans of marine or brackish habitats.

label: paca
definition: A large rodent, with dark brown or black fur, a white or yellowish underbelly and rows of white spots along its sides, native to Central America and South America.

label: pacu
definition: A freshwater species of fish belonging to the family Serrasalmidae and related to piranha.

label: panda
definition: Also *giant panda*, a white-and-black mammal of the *Ailuropoda* family, native to eastern Asia, commonly referred to as a type of bear.

label: pangolin
definition: Mammals of the order Pholidota. The one extant family, Manidae, has three genera: Manis which comprises four species living in Asia, Phataginus which comprises two species living in Africa, and Smutsia which comprises two species also living in Africa.

label: parakeet
definition: Any of several slender species of parrot.

label: parrot
definition: Any bird of the order Psittaciformes, many species of which are colourful and able to mimic human speech.

label: partridge
definition: Any of medium-sized non-migratory birds of the Phasianidae family, smaller than the pheasant but bigger than the quail.

label: pasture
definition: Land covered with grass or herbage and grazed by or suitable for grazing by livestock.

label: paw
definition: A paw is the soft foot of a mammal, generally a quadruped, that has claws.

label: peacock
definition: A male peafowl, a species of the family Phasianidae, which is known for displaying its massive tail as part of mate-selection ritual.

label: peccary
definition: The collared peccary (Pecari tajacu) is a species of mammal in the family Tayassuidae found in North, Central, and South America.

label: peck
definition: (Of a bird) to move the beak forward quickly to strike, bite, or pick up something.

label: pelican
definition: Large water birds comprising the family Pelecanidae. They are characterised by a long beak and large throat pouch used for catching prey and draining water from the scooped up contents before swallowing.

label: penguin
definition: Aquatic, flightless birds.

label: perch
definition: Perch is a common name for fish of the genus Perca, freshwater gamefish belonging to the family Percidae.

label: perch
definition: To land and rest on a perch, branch, fence, etc.

label: pet
definition: An animal or a bird that is kept at home for companionship rather than for practical use.

label: pheasant
definition: Bird of the family Phasianidae.

label: pig
definition: A common, four-legged animal (Sus scrofa) that has cloven hooves, bristles and a nose adapted for digging and is farmed by humans for its meat.

label: pig dung
definition: The faeces of a pig.

label: piglet
definition: A young pig.

label: pigsty
definition: A barn for pigs.

label: pike
definition: The northern pike is a species of carnivorous fish of the genus Esox (the pikes).

label: piranha
definition: Any of the carnivorous freshwater fish living in South American rivers and belonging to the subfamily Serrasalminae.

label: pium
definition: Hematophagous black fly found in tropical countries

label: polar bear
definition: White bear living in the northern pole regions.

label: porcupine
definition: Rodents with a coat of sharp spines, or quills, that protect against predators.

label: porpoise
definition: Short-snouted cetacean aquatic mammals of the Phocoenidae family within the superfamily Delphinoidea (along dolphins or belugas), characterized by a compact, robust body ranging from 1.2 to 2.5 metres (4 to 8 feet) in length, gregarious in habits, historically rendered for oil or used for leather.

label: possum
definition: Small to medium-sized arboreal marsupial species native to Australia, New Guinea, and Sulawesi.

label: prawns
definition: A decapod crustacean of the suborder Dendrobranchiata.

label: pregnant
definition: Describing an animal that is pregnant.

label: puma
definition: Species of feline (Puma concolor) tawny-colored with black-tipped ears and tail.

label: puppy
definition: A young dog.

label: python
definition: (Pythonidae)The common name for a group of non-venomous constricting snakes.

label: quail
definition: (Coturnix coturnix) Small (17 cm) rotund bird from the pheasant family (Phasianidae)

label: rabbit
definition: One of several small mammals of the family Leporidae, with long ears, long hind legs and a short, fluffy tail.

label: raccoon
definition: (Procyon lotor) An omnivorous nocturnal mammal native to North America and Central America.

label: ram
definition: A male sheep.

label: rat
definition: A nearly omnivorous rodent of the genus ''rattus'' characterised by a long hairless tail, rounded ears, and a pointed nose.

label: rattlesnake
definition: Poisonous snake of the genus Crotalus, known by the rattling tail.

label: raven
definition: One of several larger-bodied members of the genus Corvus. These species do not form a single taxonomic group within the genus, but share similar characteristics and appearances that generally separate them from other crows.

label: red deer
definition: The red deer (Cervus elaphus) is one of the largest deer species. A male red deer is called a stag or hart, and a female is called a hind. Red deer are ruminants, characterized by a four-chambered stomach. Genetic evidence indicates that the red deer, as traditionally defined, is a species group, rather than a single species, though exactly how many species the group includes remains disputed.

label: red-footed tortoise
definition: A medium-sized species of tortoise (Chelonoidis Carbonarius), found in northern parts of South America.

label: reindeer
definition: An Arctic and Subarctic-dwelling deer (Rangifer tarandus), a number of subspecies exist.

label: rhinoceros
definition: A group of different species of odd-toed ungulates in the family Rhinocerotidae.

label: robin
definition: The European robin (Erithacus rubecula), most commonly known in Anglophone Europe simply as the robin, is a small insectivorous passerine bird, specifically a chat, that was formerly classed as a member of the thrush family (Turdidae), but is now considered to be an Old World flycatcher.

label: rodent
definition: Any of the relatively small placental mammals that constitute the order Rodentia, having constantly growing incisor teeth specialized for gnawing.

label: roe deer
definition: Member of the species Capreolus capreolus widespread in Europe. Smaller than other deer and characterised by its red and grey-brown colour.

label: rooster
definition: A male chicken (Gallus gallus domesticus), a domestic bird.

label: roundworm
definition: A worm that belongs to Nematode species; parasitic types of roundworms infest the digestive tract of humans and other mammals.

label: ruminate
definition: (Of an animal) to chew the food brought back from the stomach and partially digested.

label: sago grub
definition: A type of snout beetle of species Rhynchophorus ferrugineus commonly known as red palm weevil, Asian palm weevil or sago palm weevil.

label: salmon
definition: One of several species of fish of the Salmonidae family.

label: sandfly
definition: A tiny flying insect from one of several species in the Nematocera suborder, including the families Mycetophilidae, Anisopodidae and Sciaridae.

label: sardine
definition: A pilchard or other fish in the herring family.

label: scale
definition: One of the small flat pieces of skin that cover the bodies of fish.

label: scorpion
definition: An arthropod with eight legs, belonging to the order Scorpiones in the class Arachnida.

label: seagull
definition: A seabird of the genus Larus or of the family Laridae.

label: seal
definition: A mammal belonging to the Pinnipedia, an order of aquatic placental mammals having a streamlined body and limbs specialized as flippers: includes seals, sea lions, and the walrus.

label: serow
definition: A short-horned, dark-coated goat antelope of southeast Asia mountain areas.

label: shark
definition: A scaleless fish with a cartilaginous skeleton that has 5 to 7 gill slits on each side of its head.

label: shear
definition: To remove the fleece from a sheep etc. by clipping.

label: sheep
definition: A common, four-legged animal (Ovis) that is commonly kept by humans for its wool.

label: sheep dung
definition: The faeces of a sheep.

label: sheepfold
definition: A barn for sheep.

label: shell
definition: A hard outer covering of an animal, as the hard case of a mollusk.

label: shrew
definition: Any of small, mole-like mammals with a long pointed snout from the family Soricidae of the order Eulipotyphla.

label: shrimp
definition: Refers to some decapod crustaceans, although the exact animals covered can vary. Used broadly, it may cover any of the groups with elongated bodies and a primarily swimming mode of locomotion – chiefly Caridea and Dendrobranchiata.

label: silkworm
definition: The larva or caterpillar of the domesticated silkmoth (Bombyx mori).

label: skin
definition: The outer tissue covering animals.

label: sloth
definition: Medium-sized mammals belonging to the families Megalonychidae (two-toed sloth) and Bradypodidae (three-toed sloth), classified into six species.

label: snail
definition: (Gastropoda) Ventral footed mollusk, including land snails, terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusks.

label: snake
definition: Any reptile of the suborder Serpentes, typically having a scaly cylindrical limbless body, fused eyelids, and a jaw modified for swallowing large prey.

label: snout
definition: The protruding portion of an animal's face, consisting of its nose, mouth, and jaw.

label: sow
definition: An adult female pig.

label: sparrow
definition: A small song bird, in the family Passeridae.

label: spawn
definition: The process by which aquatic animals produce eggs.

label: spider
definition: Any predatory silk-producing arachnid of the order Araneae, having four pairs of legs and a rounded unsegmented body consisting of abdomen and cephalothorax.

label: spider monkey
definition: Tropical American monkey of the genus Ateles,  having a slender body, long, slender limbs, and a long, prehensile tail.

label: spider web
definition: A fine net of threads woven by a spider to catch insects.

label: squid
definition: A marine cephalopod with a soft elongated body, eight arms, and two longer feeding tentacles, capable of jet propulsion and ink release.

label: squirrel
definition: A small or medium-sized rodent of the family Sciuridae.

label: stable
definition: A building or structure usually with stalls that is used to house and feed horses, cattle or other animals.

label: stallion
definition: An uncastrated male horse.

label: starfish
definition: Star-shaped echinoderm of class Asteroidea, occuring in all the world's oceans.

label: stingray
definition: Any of various large, venomous rays, of the orders Rajiformes and Myliobatiformes, having a barbed, whiplike tail.

label: stork
definition: A bird with long legs, a long beak and often black and with feathers of the family Ciconiidae.

label: sturgeon
definition: A common name denoting a fish of the Acipenseridae family.

label: swallow
definition: Any of the various passerine birds of the family Hirundinidae; martin.

label: swan
definition: Bird of the family Anatidae.

label: swarm
definition: Swarm behaviour, or swarming, is a collective behaviour exhibited by entities, particularly animals, of similar size which aggregate together, perhaps milling about the same spot or perhaps moving en masse or migrating in some direction.

label: tadpole
definition: Larval stage of amphibians.

label: takin
definition: A large goat antelope of eastern Himalayan area, Budorcas taxicolor.

label: tame
definition: Not or no longer wild (of animals).

label: tapir
definition: Any one the species of large odd-toed ungulates of the family Tapiridae with a long prehensile upper lip.

label: termite
definition: A soft-bodied insect of the order Isoptera; individuals feed on cellulose and live in colonies with a caste system comprising three types of functional individuals: sterile workers and soldiers, and the reproductives.

label: tick
definition: A small arachnid which lives on and sucks the blood of other animals including man.

label: tiger
definition: A large carnivorous animal (Panthera tigris) of the cat family indigenous to Asia.

label: tinamou
definition: Any of the 47 sedentary, ground-dwelling bird species of the order Tinamiformes found in Central and South America. It bears a strong resemblance to patridges but has limited flight capability.

label: toad
definition: Any anuran amphibian of the family Bufonidae, such as Bufo bufo of Europe. They are similar to frogs but are more terrestrial, having a drier warty skin.

label: tortoise
definition: Any herbivorous terrestrial chelonian reptile of the family Testudinidae, of most warm regions, having a heavy dome-shaped shell and clawed limbs.

label: toucan
definition: A bird with a large colorful beak, living in the tropics and belonging to the family Ramphastidae.

label: trout
definition: Fresh water salmon.

label: turkey
definition: A large bird from the family of Phasanidae.

label: turtle
definition: A reptile of the order Testudines (the crown group of the superorder Chelonia), characterised by a special bony or cartilaginous shell developed from their ribs that acts as a shield.

label: tusk
definition: A pointed elongated tooth, usually one of a pair, extending outside the mouth of a mammal.

label: untamed or wild
definition: Not cultivated, domesticated or controlled by humans.

label: vermin
definition: Small animals and insects that can be harmful and which are difficult to control when they appear in large numbers. (Source: CAMB)

label: viper
definition: A family of venomous snakes found in most parts of the world.

label: vulture
definition: Any of several carrion-eating birds of the families Accipitridae and Cathartidae.

label: wagtail
definition: Passerine bird of genus Motacilla.

label: wallaby
definition: Any of several species of marsupial; usually smaller and stockier than kangaroos.

label: walrus
definition: A very large, seal-like mammal found in Arctic seas.

label: wasp
definition: A flying stinging insect related to the bee, which is usually coloured yellow and black.

label: wasp nest
definition: The nest of wasps.

label: water buffalo
definition: A large bovid originating in South Asia, Southeast Asia, and China.

label: water leech
definition: A worm-like creature that lives in water and sucks blood from animals.

label: wax
definition: Organic solid compounds of animals or vegetal origin

label: weasel
definition: A small predator of the genus Mustela characterized by a slender body that lets it hunt burrowing animals.

label: whale
definition: Large marine mammals of the order Cetacea; the body is streamlined, the broad flat tail is used for propulsion, and the limbs are balancing structures.

label: white cockatoo
definition: Large white cockatoo, species C. galerita.

label: white-lipped peccary
definition: Piglike hoofed mammal, of North and South America, having a black gray coat with whitish cheeks; larger than the collared peccary.

label: wild animal
definition: A non-domesticated animal living independently of man.

label: wild boar
definition: Also known as wild pig, an undomestic four-legged animal (Sus scrofa) living in the wild.

label: wild cat
definition: A small cat found throughout most of Africa, Europe, and southwest and central Asia into India, China, and Mongolia.

label: wild dog
definition: Any of several wild canine species that are commonly called 'dogs' or 'wild dogs' but are not true dogs.

label: wild goose
definition: A wild goose.

label: wolf
definition: A large wild canid (Canidae), closely related to the dog.

label: wolf-like animal
definition: Refers to *genus canis*, a genus containing seven to ten extant species, including wolves, domestic dogs, coyotes, and jackals.

label: wombat
definition: Short-legged muscular quadrupedal marsupials native to Australia.

label: woodpecker
definition: Part of the Picidae family, a group of near-passerine birds that also consist of piculets, wrynecks, and sapsuckers.

label: worm
definition: A generally tubular invertebrate of the annelid phylum.

label: yak
definition: A long-haired bovid found throughout the Himalaya region of southern Central Asia, the Tibetan Plateau and as far north as Mongolia and Russia.

label: yearling
definition: A young horse between one and two years old.

label: yellow croaker
definition: A species of croaker native to the western Pacific, generally in temperate waters such as the East China Sea and the Yellow Sea.

label: young animal
definition: Like a puppy of a dog, a general term for naming younger animals.

label: young goat
definition: A young goat.

label: zebra
definition: Any of several species of genus Equus with distinctive black-and-white striped coats, native to Africa.

label: abortion
definition: An intervention in a pregnancy by removal or expulsion of an embryo or fetus resulting in termination of the pregnancy.

label: ache
definition: To be in continuous pain.

label: adam's apple
definition: A lump at the front of the neck.

label: allergy
definition: A bodily reaction due to a hypersensitivity to an antigen or a pathological immunological reaction to substances, situations, or physical states.

label: ankle
definition: A joint formed where the foot and the leg meet.

label: anus
definition: The lower opening of the digestive tract, through which faeces pass.

label: appearance
definition: The outward or visible aspect of a person or thing.

label: apply
definition: To put and spread some substance on the skin.

label: arm
definition: The upper limb, extending from the shoulder to the wrist and sometimes including the hand.

label: arm or hand
definition: Extremities emerging from the upper part of the human body.

label: armpit
definition: The hollow under the upper part of the arm at the shoulder.

label: artery
definition: A blood vessel transporting blood away from the heart.

label: awake
definition: Not sleeping.

label: back
definition: The rear of body, especially the part between the neck and the end of the spine and opposite the chest and belly.

label: back of head
definition: The back part of the head.

label: bald
definition: Without hair on the head.

label: bark or skin
definition: Cover of the bodies of animals and plants.

label: bathe
definition: To clean oneself by immersion in water.

label: bathe
definition: Clean someone else with water.

label: be alive
definition: To be alive; to have a life.

label: be alive or life
definition: The act of being alive or the life itself.

label: be born
definition: To start living.

label: be dead or death or die
definition: To be not alive or the end of a life or to cease to live.

label: beak
definition: External anatomical structure of birds which is used for taking food and for eating.

label: beard
definition: Facial hair of humans on the chin, cheeks and jaw.

label: beget
definition: (Especially of a male parent) to procreate or generate.

label: belly
definition: The lower part of the front of the torso (or a comparable part of an animal), confined by the upper side by the midriff and the lowerside by the pelvis. Contains the intestines.

label: belly or stomach
definition: The lower part of the front of the torso, including the interior part below.

label: bellybutton
definition: The middle of the belly where the umbilical cord has grown in the womb during pregnancy.

label: bile
definition: A bitter brownish-yellow or greenish-yellow secretion produced by the liver, stored in the gallbladder, and discharged into the duodenum where it aids the process of digestion.

label: birthmark
definition: A birthmark is a benign irregularity on the skin which is present at birth or appears shortly after birth, usually in the first month. Birthmarks are caused by overgrowth of blood vessels, melanocytes, smooth muscle, fat, fibroblasts, or keratinocytes.

label: bite
definition: Clamping the teeth hard on something.

label: bladder
definition: A hollow muscular balloon-shaped organ that stores urine until it is excreted from the body.

label: bleed
definition: To lose blood because of a disease or an injury.

label: blind
definition: Unable to see.

label: blink
definition: To make a quick wink of one or both eyelids, often repeatedly.

label: blister
definition: A small bubble on the skin, that contains watery fluid and is caused by heat, pressure or infection.

label: blond
definition: A pale yellowish-brown color usually of hair.

label: blood
definition: A fluid connective tissue consisting of the plasma and cells that circulate in the blood vessels.

label: blood vessel
definition: The blood vessels are the part of the circulatory system that transports blood throughout the human body or an animal body.

label: body
definition: The physical structure of a human or animal.

label: body part
definition: Part of a human body or an animal body.

label: boil
definition: A painful, local inflammation of the skin, caused by infection of a hair follicle. Usually, a hard core and pus are present.

label: bone
definition: Any of the components of an endoskeleton, consisting mainly of calcium phosphate, collagen and cells.

label: brain
definition: The organ of the central nervous system of an animal or human located in the skull that controls the actions and thoughts of the animal or human.

label: breast
definition: The fleshy organ on the chest of a sexually mature human female containing mammary glands.

label: breast milk
definition: The milk of humans.

label: breast or milk
definition: Either the organ of females which gives nourishing substance for newborns, or the substance itself.

label: breastbone
definition: Long flat bone located in the center of the chest.

label: breath
definition: The air inhaled and exhaled through the lungs.

label: breath or breathe
definition: The air that goes into one's lungs or the act of breathing.

label: breathe
definition: To repeatedly draw air into, and expel it from, the lungs, in order to extract oxygen from it and excrete waste products.

label: bruise
definition: A collection of blood in the body tissue outside the blood vessels

label: burn
definition: An injury caused by exposure to heat, fire or chemical agents.

label: buttocks
definition: The fleshy part of the human body that one sits on.

label: calf of leg
definition: The fleshy backside of the lower part of the leg.

label: carcass
definition: The body of a dead animal, on which other animals have begun to feed.

label: castrate
definition: Any action, surgical, chemical, or otherwise, by which a biological male loses use of the testicles.

label: catch a cold
definition: To become sick with a cold.

label: cheek
definition: The soft skin on each side of the face, between the eyes and the chin; the outer surface of the sides of the oral cavity.

label: chest
definition: The portion of the body from the base of the neck to the top of the abdomen; the thorax.

label: chin
definition: The bottom of the face, below the mouth.

label: claw or nail
definition: The hard, keratin part growing at the feet of animals or the hands and legs of humans.

label: clitoris
definition: A part of the female genitalia located at the front of the vulva, consisting of a sensitive erectile body.

label: close
definition: To close one's mouth.

label: coffin
definition: The box in which the body of a dead person is placed for burial.

label: collarbone
definition: Bone linking the scapula and sternum.

label: common cold
definition: A contagious, viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory system; common symptoms include cough, sore throat, runny nose, nasal congestion and sneezing.

label: conceive
definition: To become pregnant.

label: congeal
definition: The process by which frech blood gets dry and hard.

label: conjunctivitis
definition: An inflammation of the eye conjunctiva.

label: copulate
definition: To engage in sexual intercourse.

label: corpse
definition: A dead body.

label: cough
definition: To force air from the lungs out the mouth, sometimes involuntarily, accompanied by a rough sound.

label: crown
definition: A royal, imperial or princely headdress; a diadem.

label: cure
definition: To remedy an illness using medical or medicamentous treatment; to provide a cure for.

label: dandruff
definition: Small portion of dead skin cells shedding from the scalp.

label: dead
definition: Not alive; lacking life.

label: deaf
definition: Not having the faculty of hearing, or only having a restricted capability to hear.

label: death
definition: The end of life.

label: dentist
definition: A person who is medically trained and licensed to practice the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of diseases, injuries, and malformations of the teeth, jaws, and mouth.

label: diarrhea
definition: A condition in which the sufferer has frequent and watery bowel movements.

label: die
definition: To cease to live.

label: disabled person
definition: A person with a physical condition or mental disorder that is characterized by physical, sensory, cognitive or intellectual impairment.

label: disease
definition: A definite pathological process having a characteristic set of signs and symptoms which are detrimental to the well-being of the individual.

label: dislocate
definition: To (accidentally) dislodge a skeletal bone from its joint.

label: dream
definition: Successions of images, ideas, emotions, and sensations that occur usually involuntarily in the mind during certain stages of sleep.

label: dream
definition: To experience while sleeping.

label: dreaming or dream
definition: Either the act of seeing images when sleeping, or the result of this act, the dream itself.

label: dribble
definition: To let saliva flow out of one’s mouth onto one’s chin.

label: drown
definition: To be suffocated in water or other fluid; to perish by suffocation in water.

label: drowned
definition: To have perished by suffocation in water.

label: drunk
definition: Being in a temporary state in which one's physical and mental faculties are impaired due to excessive consumption of alcohol.

label: dumb
definition: Unable to speak; lacking power of speech.

label: ear
definition: The organ of hearing, consisting of the pinna, auditory canal, eardrum, malleus, incus, stapes and cochlea.

label: earhole
definition: The outer opening of the ear.

label: earlobe
definition: The lower fleshy part of the human ear.

label: earwax
definition: A yellowish, waxlike secretion from certain glands in the external auditory canal.

label: elbow
definition: The joint between arm and forearm.

label: excreta
definition: Waste matter, such as sweat, urine, or faeces, discharged from the body.

label: eye
definition: The organ that is sensitive to light, which it converts to electrical signals passed to the brain, by which means animals and humans see.

label: eyeball
definition: The partly visible orb nesting in the eye socket which contains for example pupil, retina and iris and is connected to the brain via the optic nerve.

label: eyebrow
definition: The hair that grows over the bone ridge above the eye socket.

label: eyelash
definition: One of the hairs that grows on the eyelid, around the eyes.

label: eyelid
definition: A skin flap that can be closed over an eye.

label: face
definition: The front part of the head, featuring the eyes, nose, and mouth and the surrounding area.

label: faeces
definition: Substance that human and animal bodies release from time to time as a little pile of waste remaining from digestion, after it has been collected in the colon.

label: faint
definition: To become unconscious as a result of a temporary decrease in the blood supply to the brain.

label: fall asleep
definition: To go to sleep; to change from waking state to sleeping state.

label: fart
definition: To emit digestive gases through the anus.

label: fat
definition: Esters of three fatty acid chains and the alcohol glycerol which form a semi-solid substance in room temperature and occur in animals and plants.

label: fatigue
definition: A state of physical and/or mental weakness and a lack of vigor.

label: feather
definition: A branching, hair-like structure that grows on the skin of birds and protects them against coldness and water and allows their wings to create lift.

label: feather or fur or hair
definition: The cover of a mammal or a bird.

label: fever
definition: A higher than normal temperature of a person (or generally a mammal).

label: finger
definition: One of the long extremities of the hand that is used for gripping objects.

label: fingernail
definition: The hard, flat, translucent covering near the tip of a human finger, useful for scratching and fine manipulation.

label: fingernail or toenail
definition: Hard keratin part growing at the end of a human's finger or toe.

label: fingertip
definition: The top of the finger.

label: fishbone
definition: Any of the bones forming the skeleton of a fish, especially one of the sharp slender bones attached to the backbone.

label: fist
definition: The closed hand with the fingers on the palm.

label: flesh
definition: The soft substance in the body of living things.

label: flesh or meat
definition: Either referring to the soft substance of the body of living things (flesh), or to the soft substance in animals as an important source of food for humans.

label: foot
definition: The part of a human’s body below the ankle that is used in order to stand and walk.

label: foot or leg
definition: Lower part of the human body which is used for walking.

label: footprint
definition: The impression of the foot in a soft substance such as sand or snow.

label: forefinger
definition: The finger between thumb and long finger.

label: forehead
definition: The part of the face between the hairline and the eyebrows.

label: fornicate
definition: To have sexual intercourse outside of marriage, especially with varying partners.

label: freckle
definition: A small brownish or reddish pigmentation spot on the surface of the skin.

label: front tooth
definition: Aeveral teeth located above and below in the mouth of mammals (including humans) to bite food off.

label: fur
definition: The body-hair of an animal (excluding humans) or a piece of clothing made thereof.

label: gall bladder
definition: A pear-shaped organ located beneath the liver that serves as a storage sac for bile until it is released into the small intestine.

label: genitalia
definition: The sexual organs: the testicles and penis of a male; or the labia, clitoris, and vagina of a female.

label: get tired
definition: To become tired through overuse or great strain or stress.

label: goiter
definition: Enlargement of the thyroid gland.

label: grave
definition: A place (commonly marked with a headstone) where one or more people are buried (usually in a coffin underneath the ground).
